personas.backstory: On the server since the first siege of Vodnagrad. Has never admitted losing a fight. Burned half of Mokrenka's outer farms for fun, and still brings up the Hrastovec ambush whenever {rival} logs in. Secretly respects {rival} for beating him twice.

ez clap {rival} ur turn again

personas.backstory: Joined three weeks ago and still thinks the marsh is a type of soup. Won a skirmish against four looters and has told everyone at Brezhnik about it twice. Very grateful to {rival}, who showed them not to feed grain to the soldiers.

thnk u {player} i dont get it but thnk u!! :D

Our council rewards results, as {rival} may recall.

catchphrases: the goose has noticed u {player}... :) !!
sir soggy boots would like a word, {rival}!! :D

personas.backstory: Runs caravans between Ostrogrado and Vodnagrad. Has lost eleven wagons to Hrastovec longbowmen, yet still sells them salt. Owes {rival} a discount after a salt deal fell through.

Shall we talk prices, {player}?

personas.backstory: Has played since the first war, back when the Tesnovan wardens still argued over every road. Known for free advice at the Brezhnik gate and for keeping the peace between rival lords. Once talked {rival} out of a siege that would have burned Mokrenka.

i think i just won?? is that good {player}
